description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Issuing Licence Fee and Licensing Criteria under sec. 13 of the Microfinance Act No. 06 of 2016
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules and regulations issued by the Monetary Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka under the Microfinance Act, No. 6 of 2016. It establishes licensing criteria, eligibility requirements, capital requirements, and application procedures for microfinance institutions. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to financial regulation.
